_why.rush.TITLE_SCRIM: the rush subtitle sat on the North Side grid at 2.7:1; 1.3 (alpha clamps at 1) gives 5.6:1
_why.day.BUS_CORE_R: 1.6 px dots stay sharp and visible at phone size, the Loop stops being a white cluster, strobe 0.0028 to 0.0016
_why.BASE_ROADS_GAIN: 0.75 quiets the orange street grid so the Orange and Brown lines stand out; streets still read after the round trip
_why.rush.FRAME_ZOOM: 0.9 brings the O'Hare branch and far south trains back inside x 120..800; safe share 0.887 to 0.902
_why.rush.FRAME_DY_KM: -2.6 km lifts the Dan Ryan Red Line off the clock text; safe share 0.90 to 0.93, only the far north tips meet the scrim
_why.rush.TRAIL_MINUTES: 9 min joins the Pink, Green and Blue lines into whole corridors at phone size, no fusing; strobe 0.00244 to 0.00241
_why.rush.PANEL_ALPHA: 1.32 dims the city outline under the credit line with no visible box edge; credit P99 contrast 3.8 to 4.1
